description: This file defines an abstract base class for notification action presets, specifically for wearable notifications, extending from NamedPreset and providing an abstract method to apply actions to notification builders.

classes.name: ActionsPreset
classes.description: An abstract class serving as a base for specific notification action presets, designed to be extended to customize notification actions, especially for wearable devices.

methods.name: ActionsPreset
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the preset with a resource ID for its name.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Abstract method to apply preset actions to a notification builder with wearable options, requiring implementation in subclasses.
